candidate.user_submission: Pikin no dey convulse now. Dem never get convulsion before. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Di pikin fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. I see say cloud dey cover di cornea. Di fever don last for 2 days. Di pikin get generalized rash. For dis assessment, dem never identify any bacterial cause. Di malaria risk dey high. Malaria test dey available. Result for malaria test na negative. E no get cough wey join measles. E never get measles for di last 3 months. E no get mouth ulcer. No obvious cause of fever dey. No pus dey come out from eye. Eye red dey. Nose no dey run. Neck no stiff. Temperature na 38.0°C. Age of di pikin na 18 months. E no get cough or dey breath hard. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E get fever.
